equipment/santec-tsl.title: Santec TSL tunable laser
equipment/santec-tsl.content: Santec TSL-710 tunable laser, 1480-1640 nm, swept-wavelength source for ring resonator transmission scans. Controlled over GPIB at address 1; the lab script tsl.py sets wavelength with WA and power with LP.
